jobDescription:
The Brand Manager will be responsible for building and protecting the Dish TV brand across India by planning and executing brand campaigns, marketing communication, and BTL activities. This role ensures that what Dish TV says, how it looks, and how it shows up on-ground is consistent, relevant, and effective across regions, channels, and customer touchpoints.
1. Brand Strategy & Positioning Own the Dish TV brand positioning and ensure consistency across all communication. Translate business goals into clear brand messages for different customer segments and regions. Ensure brand guidelines (logo, colors, tone, language) are followed across ATL, BTL, digital, trade, and retail.
2. Marketing Communication (Marcom) Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across: Digital Print Outdoor Radio Trade communication a. Work closely with creative agencies, media agencies, and internal teams. b. Develop campaign briefs, approve creatives, and manage timelines. c. Adapt national campaigns into regional and language-specific communication. d. Ensure relevance for Hindi-speaking markets (HSM) and South markets.
3. BTL & On-Ground Activations Own BTL strategy to support
- New subscriber acquisition, Regional launches, Festive offers, Trade and dealer activations Design and execute: Retail branding, Dealer boards, danglers, standees Local activations, roadshows, society activations Coordinate with sales, trade marketing, and regional teams for execution.
4. Campaign Planning & Execution Create annual and quarterly brand calendars. Manage campaign budgets and ensure ROI discipline. Track campaign performance using: Reach & frequency Brand recall Footfall uplift Lead / enquiry impact (where applicable)
5. Stakeholder Management Act as the single point of contact for branding across teams
- Product, Digital marketing, Sales & Trade, Customer experience Manage agencies and vendors end-to-end. Key Deliverables (What success looks like) Strong, consistent Dish TV brand presence across India High-quality campaign execution (on-time, on-brand) Effective BTL programs that support sales teams Improved brand recall and consideration Smooth coordination between brand, sales, and digital teams 6-10 years of experience in: Brand management Marketing communication BTL / activation-heavy roles Experience in consumer-facing brands preferred: Telecom FMCG Consumer electronics Media / Entertainment Hands-on experience with regional marketing and multi-language campaigns is a must. Detail-oriented but big-picture thinker Strong ownership mindset Comfortable with ambiguity and fast execution Good balance of creativity and business thinking Can handle pressure during launches and festive peaks Nice to Have (Not Mandatory) Experience in subscription-based businesses Exposure to rural / semi-urban markets Experience with large-scale campaigns
